To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the quark-pion interaction can generate a repulsive NN core and a medium range attraction, that the quark exchange mechanism can produce a strong tensor force and that the quark model provides a consistent framework for the NN interaction.

the quark-one pion exchange potential (QOPE), a potential that describes the interaction of quarks in the constituent nucleon via the exchange of a single pion between them, has the correct qualitative features to describe the NN interaction.
the NN interaction is dominated by the exchange of pions between the quarks of the two nucleons and that the NN interaction can be described in terms of a potential based on quark-one-pi exchange.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of quarks and gluons in the nucleon structure and their influence on the NN interaction.
the effects of quark structure on the NN interaction and the NN scattering.
the effects of quark structure on nucleon-nucleus interactions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the QOPEP potential is qualitatively in agreement with the meson exchange NN potentials, and quantitatively, the QOPEPNN potential is comparable to the meson-exchanged NN potentials in the short-range and the medium-range.
the quark exchange is the origin of the repulsive core, and the overlap is the origin of medium-range attraction.
the QOPEP model provides a reasonable description of the NN interaction.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the NN interaction is a complicated interplay of the quark structure of the nucleon and the mesonic exchange between the nucleons.
the quark-pion interaction is a good candidate for the NN interaction.
the NN interaction can be well described by the QOPEP, and that the quark structure of the nucleon plays a crucial role in the NN interaction.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the nucleon structure effects in the NN interaction are significant and should be included in the theoretical models for nuclear forces.
the nucleon structure plays an important role in the nucleon interaction.
the NN interaction has a natural explanation in terms of quark exchange and meson exchange between quarks.
